cwes recorded as ["078"]: the operator narrowed pass 2 to CWE-78 and the schema pattern ^[0-9]{2,4}$ forbids the "CWE-" prefix.

LLM labeling executed in 14 batches (B1-B14, see labels_raw_pass2.json metadata) over all 7204 candidate rows: 7034 from sources.csv + 170 from sinks.csv; every row is labeled in labels_raw_pass2.json.

labels.json entries are deduplicated signatures built from production rows only; test-file rows (raw-level fp), devscript/build rows and non-command CLI option reads are excluded from entries with reasons recorded in labels/label_stats.md.

No sanitizer entries: no candidate demonstrated concrete neutralization of command-injection taint. Partial mitigations exist but are not sanitizers: exec.py:24 shlex-quotes only the legacy {} filepath placeholder; extractor/common.py:1309 substitutes netrc_machine unquoted; "--" separators before URLs (downloader/external.py:223, sponskrub.py:83) and shlex.split (sponskrub.py:81, Config.read_file) prevent shell-string interpretation but do not sanitize command content.

Only 3 shell=True string-command sites exist in production code: postprocessor/exec.py:31 (--exec), extractor/common.py:1311 (--netrc-cmd) and update.py:376 (Windows updater delayed delete, program-controlled path). All other exec sites use argv lists without a shell.
Model self-identification: labeling was performed by glm-5.3 operating as the Claude Code CLI agent, single pass with source grounding; temperature 0 semantics (deterministic decision table).
No PyVul ground truth, vulnerability fix commits or external security advisories were consulted.
